title: Step 7a - Visualizing Logistic Regression Decision Boundaries in Python: 2D Plot

cues.en: Narrator: All right, my friends here we are at the final step of this implementation.
cues.zh: 各位，來到這份實作最後一步。

cues.en: And actually the most exciting one because this is the step where we're going to visualize on a nice 2D plot, the prediction curve and the prediction regions
cues.zh: 也是最令人期待的部分，要用漂亮的二維圖，呈現邏輯斯迴歸的預測曲線與預測區域，

cues.en: of the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 也就是模型的結果。

cues.en: All right, so more specifically what we're about to plot is a two dimensional plot with therefore two axis X and Y.
cues.zh: 更具體地，二維圖有 x、y 兩個軸。

cues.en: On the X axis you will have the first feature corresponding to the H, and on the Y axis you'll have the second feature corresponding to the estimated salary.
cues.zh: x 軸是第一個特徵年齡，y 軸是第二個特徵估計薪資。

cues.en: And therefore each of the observation points you will see under 2D plot will correspond to a specific customer.
cues.zh: 每個觀測點都對應一位顧客。

cues.en: It'll either be a customer of the training set, you know on the plot of the training set results or a customer of the test set, on the plot of the test set results.
cues.zh: 訓練結果圖中的點是訓練顧客，測試結果圖中的點則是測試顧客。

cues.en: And what is most interesting to see in this plot will be the prediction regions meaning the regions
cues.zh: 最有趣的是預測區域，也就是

cues.en: where our logistic regression model predicts the class zero, meaning the customers didn't buy the SUV and the other region where our logistic regression model predicts
cues.zh: 模型預測為 0、沒買 SUV 的區域，以及預測

cues.en: the class one meaning the customer bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 為 1、買了 SUV 的區域。

cues.en: And lastly, what will be really interesting to see is the curve separating these two regions.
cues.zh: 最後，分隔兩區的曲線也很值得觀察。

cues.en: You know, the region of the prediction zero and the region of the predictions one.
cues.zh: 一邊預測 0，另一邊預測 1。

cues.en: And this is exactly how we are gonna see the difference between linear classifiers and non-linear classifiers.
cues.zh: 這正是看出線性與非線性分類器差別的方式。

cues.en: So here we are only starting with one classification model, logistic regression.
cues.zh: 目前先從邏輯斯迴歸一個模型開始。

cues.en: So we won't compare that yet, but you will see in the next sections of this part that the prediction boundary between these two prediction regions
cues.zh: 所以還不比較，但後面你會看到，兩個區域間的預測邊界，

cues.en: will be different depending on whether or not your classifier is linear.
cues.zh: 會依分類器是否線性而不同。

cues.en: All right, so I can't wait to show you this and let's start first by visualizing these training set and tested results for the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 很期待展示，先視覺化邏輯斯迴歸的訓練與測試結果。

cues.en: All right, so the code to visualize this is actually pretty advanced, and not only it is pretty advanced but also you will probably never use
cues.zh: 視覺化程式其實相當進階，而且你未來職涯可能不會再

cues.en: it again in your career, or let's say you will never have to implement that again.
cues.zh: 用到，或至少不必自己重寫。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: It's because in your career you will mostly work with datasets having many features, you know, more than two.
cues.zh: 因為職場大多處理多特徵資料，通常超過兩個。

cues.en: And here the only reason why we have a data set of two features is so that we can be able to visualize indeed, while these prediction regions and prediction boundary, because indeed,
cues.zh: 這裡只取兩個特徵，唯一原因就是能看見預測區域與邊界，

cues.en: in order to visualize this, we need maximum two features because one feature corresponds to one dimension in this plot.
cues.zh: 因為一個特徵對應一個維度，所以這種圖最多兩個特徵。

cues.en: So what I suggest is that we don't waste too much time you know, understanding the whole code and reimplement it ourselves because really I'm gonna show
cues.zh: 建議別花太多時間理解、重新撰寫整段，我直接

cues.en: it to you right away.
cues.zh: 展示給你看。

cues.en: You know, on the original logistic regression implementation, you will see that the code is pretty advanced.
cues.zh: 在原始邏輯斯迴歸實作裡，可以看到程式相當進階。

cues.en: You know, it's not like plotting a regression curve like we did in part two.
cues.zh: 不像第二部分只是畫迴歸曲線。

cues.en: So that's the tested results.
cues.zh: 這是測試結果。

cues.en: Let me show you the train set results.
cues.zh: 再看訓練結果。

cues.en: All right, so that's the code.
cues.zh: 這就是程式碼。

cues.en: You see, it uses a lot of tricks to plot all these observation points, prediction regions, and prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 用了許多技巧，繪製觀測點、預測區域與邊界。

cues.en: So if you want to have a look at it and understand it fine, but really for the others it's totally okay if we don't cover this code in detail because this is only for training purposes
cues.zh: 想深入了解當然可以，但其他人不必擔心，我們不逐行介紹，因為只是為了教學，

cues.en: just so that I can show you the differences between linear classifiers and non-linear classifiers and you will probably never use that again in your future machine learning project.
cues.zh: 展示線性與非線性分類器的差異；未來專案可能不會再用。

cues.en: However, what I will do just now is explain how it's done.
cues.zh: 不過我會說明基本做法。

cues.en: Basically what we do is we create, as you can see, a grid which is basically this frame here containing all the ages of your future and all the estimated salaries, you know the ranges.
cues.zh: 建立網格，也就是涵蓋所有年齡與估計薪資範圍的框架。

cues.en: And you create this grid with a high density, meaning that the pixels of this grid are not separated one by one but every 0.25.
cues.zh: 網格非常密集，格點不是每次間隔 1，而是 0.25。

cues.en: So here, for example, for the age it goes this way it goes from 10 to 10.25 to 10.5 to 10.75 to 11, et cetera up to 69, 69.25, 69.5,
And same for the estimated salary, it goes from 20,000, then 20000.25, 20000.5, et cetera up to somewhere
around 149000, 149000.25 you see so resulting in having super dense points inside this grid.
cues.zh: 149000、149000.25，因此網格中有非常密集的點。

cues.en: And then the trick, you know, what we did is not only we plotted all the real observation points in the grids, so all the points that you see here are the customers
cues.zh: 然後，不只畫真實觀測點，也就是這裡看到的顧客，

cues.en: of either your training sets and then later on your test set.
cues.zh: 包括訓練集，稍後也有測試集。

cues.en: The green points are of course the customers who bought the SUV, you know represented by one here.
cues.zh: 綠點當然是買了 SUV 的顧客，以 1 表示。

cues.en: And the red points are of course the customers who didn't buy the SUV represented by zero here, okay?
cues.zh: 紅點則是沒買的顧客，以 0 表示。

cues.en: So all the points are your observation points, your customers.
cues.zh: 所有這些點都是顧客觀測。

cues.en: And then, so the trick in order to plot the prediction regions and therefore that prediction boundary here separating the two regions, is to apply the predict method
cues.zh: 要畫預測區域，以及分隔區域的邊界，技巧是對

cues.en: onto each of these dense points in the grid so that all the dense points here, you know in this region were actually predicted
cues.zh: 網格中的每個密集點呼叫 predict。這一區所有點

cues.en: to be zero meaning all the customers, you know, other customers inside this region are predicted not to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 都預測為 0，代表落在此區的顧客，都預測不會買 SUV。

cues.en: And all the observation points in this green region are actually predicted to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠色區域內則預測會買 SUV。

cues.en: So you see how this works?
cues.zh: 了解如何運作了嗎？

cues.en: That's the trick.
cues.zh: 這就是技巧。

cues.en: And then really you don't have to understand all the techniques used to implement this because once again you will probably never have to implement that kind of code in your career.
cues.zh: 不一定要理解實作中的全部技術，因為未來職涯可能不用親自撰寫這種程式。
